topic: Explanation of inertial navigation system and integration with MHRS system.
syllabus_extract: Explanation of inertial navigation system and integration with MHRS system.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS integration diagrams; Instructor supervision required for system logic verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an Inertial Navigation System?
How does the AFCS utilize inertial data for aircraft control?
What is the role of the MHRS in integrating navigation systems?

topics: Data flow between INS and AFCS

summary_questions: Explain how the AFCS uses inertial data to maintain aircraft attitude.
Describe the process by which the MHRS detects an INS failure.
What are the primary sources of error in an inertial navigation system?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the integration of the inertial navigation system with the MHRS, focusing on data exchange protocols and redundancy measures, to be submitted in the next lesson (LP 02).
